action_items: CRITICAL: Fix GET /api/transactions 500. Recommended: db.transactions.update_many({user_id:'admin-emilio-001', category:{$exists:false}}, {$set:{category:'otros'}}) and/or make TransactionBase.category Optional in models.py to be defensive. Without this, the entire Movimientos>Todos tab is unusable.
Re-run frontend badge verification (tx-category slate pill, tx-validated emerald, tx-auto slate+gear) after the 500 is resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: models.py TransactionBase.category is `str` (required) but the migration script unsets fields (diferido/ingreso) and creates rows with no category — the model contract is too strict for the data on disk. Make it Optional[str] = None or normalize on read.

routes/transactions.py line 80 builds TransactionResponse via dict-spread without try/except — a single bad doc 500s the whole endpoint and renders the Movimientos page empty. Wrap per-item with try/except or use model_validate(... strict=False) and skip/coerce malformed rows with a structured warning.

MiDinero.js / Fiscal.js / Movimientos.js useEffect that syncs ?tab=<x> to URL has [tab, location.pathname, location.search, navigate] deps — when location.search changes after navigate(replace) it re-fires; harmless because guarded by `current !== tab`, but consider trimming deps to [tab] to avoid noisy renders.
Migration of sri_category 'deducible'→null is one-way: there's no audit trail. Future migrations should record applied_at + counts in a migrations collection.

rca of the issue: PARTE A migration ('diferido/ingreso' → unset, sri_category 'deducible'→null) left some transaction documents without a 'category' field. TransactionBase declares `category: str` (required). routes/transactions.py line 80 builds TransactionResponse(**t) for every Mongo doc; the first malformed doc raises pydantic ValidationError → uvicorn returns 500 → frontend Movimientos>Todos shows empty 'No hay transacciones que mostrar'. Reproduction: login as earauzt@gmail.com, navigate to /movimientos?tab=todos → DevTools shows GET /api/transactions 500. Mitigation: either backfill missing category to 'otros' OR make models.py TransactionBase.category Optional[str]=None (defensive).
